briefs.headline: Purdue pulls away in the second half to beat Ohio 80-62 at Mackey Arena
briefs.summary: Gicarri Harris scored 23 points, 15 of them after halftime, when he made 5 of 6 shots and all three of his 3-point tries and Purdue shot 54% from the floor to turn a 43-36 lead into 56-41 with 9 1/2 minutes left in West Lafayette, Ind., on Friday night; the Bobcats got within 61-51 with seven minutes to go before the margin went back to 18. Jackson Paveletzke scored 16, Javan Simmons 12 and Siebe Ledegen 10 for Ohio, which turned the ball over nine times in a first half it trailed 37-28 despite holding the Boilermakers to 35% shooting, per AP. Ohio is 2-1 and hosts Morehead State on Wednesday at 7 p.m. ET.

briefs.headline: Spurs score the first 18 points and rout the Warriors 123-85 for an 11th straight win
briefs.summary: Stephon Castle scored a season-high 32 points in 25 minutes, 12 of 18 from the floor and 5 of 8 from 3-point range, Victor Wembanyama had 12 points and 12 rebounds in 21 minutes, and San Antonio led 38 to 14 after a first quarter in which Golden State shot 5 of 25 and 63 to 33 at the half, the fewest points by a Spurs opponent in a half since 2018, in Friday night's NBA Cup game at the Frost Bank Center; the lead reached 43 in the third quarter and the starters sat the fourth, per AP. ESPN reported the opening run of 18 straight points was the Spurs' largest to start a game in 30 seasons and the largest allowed by Golden State under Steve Kerr, who called San Antonio the best team in the league; the Warriors, without Stephen Curry, lost by their widest margin since January 2025, and Draymond Green drew a flagrant foul for a shove that sent Wembanyama out of bounds. San Antonio, with 11 wins in 13 games and unbeaten in Cup play, visits Utah on Sunday at 5 p.m. ET.

briefs.headline: Pochettino confirms he leaves the USMNT on Tuesday; Cherundolo takes the December camp
briefs.summary: Mauricio Pochettino said at a news conference Friday, flanked by U.S. Soccer CEO JT Batson and president Cindy Parlow Cone, that he will leave after Tuesday's second leg against Haiti to manage Manchester United on a two-and-a-half-year contract finalized Thursday, calling it the most difficult decision of his career and saying the players understood; Steve Cherundolo, the under-23 coach, will run the previously scheduled December camp of a mostly MLS-based roster, and the federation said women's coach Emma Hayes will take part in the search for a successor alongside Batson, Dan Helfrich and Oguchi Onyewu, per ESPN. Pochettino, with 21 wins, 12 losses and two draws since September 2024 with a World Cup round-of-16 run, coaches Saturday's first leg in Miami at 4:30 p.m. ET; United pay a release fee ESPN put at about $10 million.

briefs.headline: Kansas-WVU kickoff moves up 2 hours to 3:30 p.m. ET and shifts to ESPN2
briefs.summary: West Virginia's home game against Kansas at Milan Puskar Stadium was moved from 5:30 to 3:30 p.m. ET and from ESPNU to ESPN2, MetroNews reported Friday night, after the FAA's national ground stop disrupted college football travel; the Jayhawks had landed in Morgantown before the stop took effect. West Virginia has five wins and four losses, Kansas three wins and six losses, and the ESPN schedule read this morning carries the 3:30 p.m. ET start with no broadcaster listed. The basketball team, unbeaten in three games, plays Auburn in Las Vegas on Tuesday; Auburn lost at home to No. 12 Arizona by 11 points on Friday night.

briefs.headline: Onosato wins a 6th straight and 7 share the Kyushu lead at one loss after day 7
briefs.summary: Yokozuna (grand champion) Onosato, chasing a second straight yusho (championship), forced out new komusubi (junior champion) Mitonoumi on day 7 at the Fukuoka Kokusai Center on Saturday for a sixth win in a row since his opening-day loss, and the Japan Sumo Association's tournament leaders page lists seven rikishi (wrestlers) at six wins and one loss in the top division: Onosato, ozeki (champion) Kirishima, who forced out Hakunofuji, sekiwake Atamifuji, who forced out Fujiryoga a day after his first defeat, and maegashira (rank-and-file) Wakamotoharu, Kinbozan, Asahakuryu and Arashifuji. Ozeki Aonishiki fell to a third loss on maegashira 2 Fujiseiun's overarm throw, ozeki Kotozakura pushed out Ura for a fifth win, and sekiwake Fujinokawa was pushed over by Asanoyama for a fifth loss, per Sports Hochi. Onosato has never won the Kyushu tournament; the final day is Sunday, Nov. 22.

briefs.headline: Hoshoryu wins a 2nd straight to reach 4 wins after the withdrawal talk, with Hakkaku urging him on
briefs.summary: Yokozuna (grand champion) Hoshoryu beat komusubi (junior champion) Yoshinofuji on day 7 in Fukuoka on Saturday with a sotogake (outside leg trip) after taking a right underarm grip off the tachiai (initial charge), his second win in a row after giving up kinboshi (gold stars, a rank-and-filer's win over a yokozuna) on three straight days earlier in the week and, Sports Hochi reported, coming close to withdrawing; he said he was not thinking about having a winning record, that what was done was done, and that he would concentrate on the next day. JSA chairman Hakkaku, the former yokozuna Hokutoumi, said what matters for Hoshoryu is to keep competing. Yoshinofuji took a third loss.

briefs.headline: Adebayo and Antetokounmpo score 37 apiece as the Heat beat the Cavaliers 133-121
briefs.summary: Bam Adebayo had 37 points and 14 rebounds, Giannis Antetokounmpo also scored 37 and Davion Mitchell had 22 points and a career-high-tying 17 assists in Miami on Friday night, the second time two Heat players have scored 37 in a game after LeBron James and Dwyane Wade in 2013; Donovan Mitchell scored 25 for Cleveland, which played without Evan Mobley, whose sprained left big toe had a clean MRI, per AP. Miami has won both of its NBA Cup games and is alone atop East Group B; Cleveland has split its two and has six wins in 13 games.

briefs.headline: Sengun scores 43 as the Rockets hold off the Jazz 125-118 for Utah's 11th straight loss
briefs.summary: Alperen Sengun had 43 points on 17 of 24 shooting and 12 rebounds, his second career 40-point game, and Kevin Durant iced it from the line after Utah had closed within two possessions in the final minute in Houston on Friday night; Darryn Peterson scored 28 and Keyonte George 27 for the Jazz, whose only win this season came in their second game, per AP. Houston has 10 wins in 13 games and is a game behind the Spurs and Lakers in the West; Utah, with one win in 13 games, hosts San Antonio on Sunday.

briefs.headline: Avdija's 34 lead the Trail Blazers past the Kings 120-107 for a 3rd straight win
briefs.summary: Deni Avdija made 11 of 13 shots and all nine of his free throws for 34 points, Damian Lillard added 29 and Portland opened a six-game trip with its third straight win in Sacramento on Friday night, its sixth win in seven road games; De'Andre Hunter scored 24 and Domantas Sabonis had 21 points and 12 rebounds for the Kings, who have lost five straight, have one win in 12 games and are winless in seven at home, per AP. Portland has nine wins in 12 games.

briefs.headline: Josi's shootout goal gives the Predators a 3-2 win in Vegas and a 7th straight victory
briefs.summary: Roman Josi scored in the fourth round of the shootout after Filip Forsberg had kept Nashville alive in the third, Ryan O'Reilly scored both regulation goals for his eighth and ninth of the season and Juuse Saros made 40 saves on Friday night in Las Vegas; Victor Olofsson and Rasmus Andersson scored for Vegas, whose four-game winning streak ended, and Adin Hill stopped 30, per AP. Nashville is 11-4-5 with four straight road wins and a 1.63 goals-against average over the streak's first six games.

briefs.headline: Gawdin's first 2 NHL goals carry the Rangers past the Canucks 5-1
briefs.summary: Glenn Gawdin, 29, a Richmond, British Columbia, native called up from Hartford on Tuesday, scored twice in a four-goal second period in Vancouver on Friday night, and the Rangers won for the first time this season after allowing the first goal, having been 0-7-1 in those games; Dylan Garand made 27 saves, Elias Pettersson opened the scoring on an assist that gave Brock Boeser his 500th NHL point, per AP. New York is 12-8-1 with three wins on a four-game trip; the NHL-worst Canucks have lost seven straight and are 3-17-1.

briefs.headline: Colorado beats No. 14 Houston 42-32 for its first top-15 win since 2007
briefs.summary: Trailing 20-7 late in the first half in Boulder on Friday night, Colorado scored 28 straight points and ran for 249 yards, the most of Deion Sanders' four seasons, with five rushing touchdowns and four scores of 32 yards or more; Isaac Wilson limped off in the third quarter and Kaneal Sweetwyne scored on his first play, per AP. The Buffaloes, 4-6 and 2-5 in the Big 12, must win out to be bowl eligible; Houston, 7-3, visits West Virginia on Nov. 21, and Sanders is 20-27 at Colorado.

briefs.headline: Dieffenbach returns from an elbow injury and No. 4 UCLA holds off Illinois 22-14 to reach 10-0
briefs.summary: Ty Dieffenbach left with 35 seconds to go in the first half after falling on his left elbow, came back with 55 seconds left in the third quarter and threw a 26-yard touchdown to Semaje Morgan on his first drive back, finishing with 232 yards and two scores in the rain at the Rose Bowl on Friday night; Aiden Mizell had six catches for 176 yards and a touchdown and Scooter Jackson intercepted twice, the second with 2:50 left, per AP. UCLA, 10-0 and 7-0 in the Big Ten, is No. 4 in the College Football Playoff rankings and 10-0 for the third time in program history; Illinois is 6-4.

briefs.headline: No. 4 UConn pulls away from Ohio State 84-68 after the Buckeyes wipe out a 14-point deficit
briefs.summary: Braylon Mullins hit five 3-pointers for 22 points before limping off with 6:07 left and Na'jai Hines scored 17 of his 20 in the second half in Hartford, Conn., on Friday night, after Ohio State had ended the first half on a 13-1 run and led five times early in the second; Jimmie Williams scored 17 and John Mobley Jr. 16 for the Buckeyes, who fell to 2-2, per AP. UConn, 4-0 and without Nik Khamenia for several weeks with a foot injury, visits No. 12 Arizona on Wednesday.

briefs.headline: Arizona ends Auburn's 69-game nonconference home streak with an 80-69 win
briefs.summary: Freshman Caleb Holt, an Alabama native, had 24 points, nine rebounds and five steals, Ivan Kharchenkov scored 19 and Motiejus Krivas had 16 points and 12 rebounds for No. 12 Arizona on Friday night, which went 18 of 22 from the line and outrebounded Auburn 49-37; the Tigers erased a 14-point second-half deficit to lead 61-59 with 7:12 left before a 9-0 Wildcats run, and Thomas Dowd had 15 points and nine rebounds, per AP. Arizona is 3-1; Auburn, 2-1 and 23 of 66 from the floor, plays West Virginia in Las Vegas on Tuesday.

waters.reading: 139 cfs, 1.83 feet at 5:15 a.m., rising on both flow and stage against 42.0 cfs and 1.23 feet in the fetcher's 24-hour comparison.
waters.working: The rise that began Thursday has carried the gauge at Dyer to more than three times its 24-hour-ago reading, and the stage is up six tenths of a foot on the day; the fetcher still reads it as prime wading water, and 139 cfs is a comfortable wade on the Williams, but it is rising water with the first real colour of the fall in it, so the trout are off the shallow pocket-water lies and on the seams and the soft inside edges of the plunge pools. That makes it a heavy-nymph-on-the-seam morning rather than a long-leader problem: a stonefly or a caddis pupa under enough weight to find the bottom of the pools, and with the water up and off-colour a sculpin or a small black streamer swung tight to the undercut banks. If the rise continues through the day the pools will fish better than the pocket water, and the wading gets harder than the number suggests.

waters.near: 14 miles above R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.reading: 24.82 feet at 5 a.m., falling against 25.08 in the fetcher's comparison.
waters.read: 24.8 ft and falling — normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Normal pool with ordinary bank access, a quarter of a foot lower than this time Friday, and the lowest the pool side has read this week: the wing dams and the riprap are showing rock. Shad are the forage, so a white or shad-pattern swimbait or a lipless crankbait worked down the exposed face of the wing dams and along the riprap is the pattern on a falling pool, with a jig and crawfish on the slack side of the lock wall for the fish that have pulled off the structure as the water dropped. The R.C. Byrd tailwater itself is not gauged; this is the pool side.
waters.source: USGS 03201500 (Ohio River at Point Pleasant); config.SPORTSMAN_WATERS

waters.near: below R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.reading: 25.93 feet at 5 a.m., steady against 25.85 in the fetcher's comparison.
waters.read: 25.9 ft — normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Normal pool and the steadiest of the three gauges, within a tenth of a foot of Friday's reading while the pool above the dam falls. Below the dam the pattern is the structure the dam makes: skipjack and shad stack in the current below the gates, and a spoon or a heavy jig worked in the churn, or a live skipjack drifted along the current seams off the lock wall, is the hybrid and catfish setup at this stage; the riprap along the Huntington bank fishes a crawfish-colour jig on the slack side where the bank current breaks. Huntington is the downstream bracket, 30-odd river miles below the dam, not the tailwater reading, which the Corps publish and this pipeline cannot fetch.

waters.reading: Sound at Hampstead: low 4:57 AM at 0.6 ft, high 11:29 AM at 3.8 ft, low 5:51 PM at 1.0 ft, high 11:44 PM at 2.9 ft. Surf at Ocean City Beach pier: low 3:36 AM at 0.9 ft, high 10:19 AM at 4.7 ft, low 4:55 PM at 1.0 ft, high 10:41 PM at 3.3 ft. Water 63.3F at Beaufort, 60 miles up the coast, observed 5:30 a.m. Moon waxing crescent, 21% illuminated, 4.5 days old.
waters.read: Fish the moving water either side of high at 11:29 AM and 11:44 PM in the sound.
waters.working: All four sound events land inside the calendar day, the 4:57 a.m. low just behind us at press time, and the sound lags the surf by 81 minutes on the morning low, 70 on the morning high, 56 on the afternoon low and 63 on the evening high, the shallow sound draining slower than it fills. The whole table is about 40 minutes later than Friday's, the morning range is 3.2 feet against 1.9 in the evening, and at 21% and four and a half days old the moon is heading for the first-quarter neap, so the inlet current eases a little each day and tonight's 2.9-foot high is the soft tide of the day. No current local report could be read this morning: the Fisherman's Post Topsail and Sneads Ferry feed returned a Cloudflare 403 at 5:45 a.m., and Coastal Angler's newest Topsail report is dated Sept. 1, well past the 21-day gate, so what follows is the reference file's November pattern, not a live report: red drum, speckled trout at their prime, bluefish, spot, sea mullet and blow toads. Tied to today's table, the flood runs from the 4:57 low to the 11:29 high, and the trout window is the first of the ebb after it, roughly 11:45 a.m. to 2 p.m., a popping cork with live shrimp over the oyster bars at the creek mouths and then a light jig head and a small soft plastic in the deeper creek-channel holes as the water leaves the grass, with the water at Beaufort down to 63.3F keeping fish in the deeper holes through the afternoon. Red drum want the last of the fall, roughly 3:15 to the 5:51 p.m. low, cut menhaden or a finger mullet on a quarter-ounce head a couple of feet off the creek-channel edges; the evening flood into the 11:44 p.m. high is short on water, so the flooded-grass window for a weedless gold spoon is brief tonight. Spot and sea mullet on bloodworm or shrimp on a two-hook bottom rig in the ICWW channel an hour either side of the evening high; bluefish are the early-morning fish on the beach behind the bait pods on a metal jig. Flounder are release only. NWS has a Freeze Warning for Inland Pender and Coastal Onslow counties until 9 a.m. Sunday and no rip current or beach hazards statement for Pender or Onslow in the active alerts list read at 5:45 a.m.
